summary: Sporting News previews the Scooter's Coffee Frisco Bowl between UTSA (8-4) and Marshall (6-6), with UTSA a large favorite. The piece covers team trends, transfer-portal opt-outs on both sides, BetMGM player props, and a pick of UTSA. The author argues UTSA's offense led by Frank Harris will overwhelm a depleted Marshall led by freshman QB Cole Pennington.
one_line: Sporting News previews the Frisco Bowl, picking heavily favored UTSA over a transfer-portal-depleted Marshall and listing odds context and player props.
key_facts: UTSA (8-4) plays Marshall (6-6) on Tuesday night in the Scooter's Coffee Frisco Bowl at 9 p.m. ET on ESPN.
UTSA is in its 13th season as a program, has yet to win a bowl game, and this is its fourth bowl in five years.
Marshall is playing in a bowl game for the seventh straight year.
UTSA has won seven of its last eight games, while Marshall has lost six of its last eight.
UTSA lost 29-16 to Tulane in its last outing but had scored at least 34 points in every win since Oct. 7.
UTSA QB Frank Harris completed 64.9% of passes for 2,506 yards and 18 touchdowns this season, down from 4,059 yards and 32 TDs on a 69.6% rate last year.
UTSA WR Joshua Cephus caught 82 passes for 1,049 yards and nine touchdowns.
UTSA averaged 31.7 points and 424.6 total yards per game, ranking 37th and 39th nationally; the defense allowed an 87.5% red-zone score rate (99th).
UTSA is 5-6-1 ATS and 4-7-1 to the OVER; Marshall is 4-8 ATS and 6-6 on the O/U.
UTSA will be without EDGE Trey Moore, its best defensive player and the conference sack leader, who is entering the transfer portal to seek a Power 5 school.
Marshall will be without starting QB Cam Fancher and will start freshman Cole Pennington, son of former Marshall QB Chad Pennington, who has six interceptions, zero touchdowns and 79 pass attempts.
Marshall RB Rasheen Ali has 1,256 yards and 15 touchdowns; Marshall ranks 93rd in scoring and 89th in yards per game and won only three of eight conference games.
Marshall has 18 players listed as opting out via the transfer portal.
BetMGM props include Frank Harris at 237.5 passing yards and Rasheen Ali at 80.5 rushing yards (both OVER/UNDER -115).
The article's pick is UTSA, despite the big spread.
